Use this skill when the user intent is **product search** (find products, compare, view details) or **supplier search** (find suppliers, manufacturers, factories). This covers keywords in any language related to product sourcing, supplier discovery, factory search, procurement, etc.

## Default Source: alibaba.com

The `product_supplier_search` tool searches **alibaba.com** by default. When the user does not specify a platform, always use this tool.

### If the user specifies another platform

If the user explicitly asks to source from a different platform (e.g. 1688.com, Amazon, Temu, Made-in-China, Global Sources, etc.):

1. **Do NOT blindly call `product_supplier_search`** — it only covers alibaba.com.
2. Check whether there is an available tool or MCP method for that platform (e.g. search for tools containing the platform name).

body: # Supplier Performance Manager

## Overview

Reliable supply chain operations are built on structured vendor management. Beyond simply placing orders, effective "Performance Management" involves tracking lead times, fill rates, and quality consistency to mitigate stockout risks and negotiate better terms. This skill focuses on the technical workflow of Purchase Orders (POs), receipt reconciliation, and data-driven supplier evaluation.

## Strategic Sourcing Framework

| Metric | Definition | Benchmark |
|--------|------------|-----------|
| **Fill Rate** | % of ordered units actually received. | > 95% |
| **On-Time Delivery** | % of POs delivered within the quoted lead time. | > 90% |
| **Defect Rate** | % of units rejected during Quality Control (QC). | < 1.5% |
| **Lead Time Variance** | Standard deviation of historical delivery times. | < 3 Days |

### Decision Criteria: Domestic vs. International Sourcing
- **Domestic:** Higher unit cost but lower lead times (3-7 days). Best for "Trending" products with high demand volatility.
- **International:** Lower unit cost but high lead times (30-90 days) and increased risk (Customs, Port delays). Best for "Stable" hero products with predictable demand.

body: # trend-stage-timing-analyzer

本 Skill 的唯一职责：判断 **现在是不是正确时点**。

它不是单纯看 Google Trends 的工具，而是要把：

- 公开趋势信号
- 私有先行指标
- 竞品动作

三类信息合在一起，告诉 Momcozy：

**该追、该等、还是该绕开。**

---

## 核心原则：公开信号只能告诉你“大家都看见了什么”

Google Trends、Amazon BSR、TikTok 热门标签都很有用，但它们属于公开信号。

真正更有价值的是：

- DTC 某类页面访问突然上升，但转化不高
- 客服里同类问题突然增多
- 社群里开始出现某个新场景词
- 竞品开始招聘某类产品经理、申请专利、加大某类广告

所以本 Skill 默认区分两层：

| 层级 | 意义 |
|------|------|
| 公开趋势 | 所有人都能看到的市场变化 |
| 私有先行指标 | 更早、更贴近 Momcozy 决策的变化 |

---

## 标准工作流

### 第一步：界定分析对象

不要只写大品类，尽量具体到“子趋势组合”。

例如不要只写：

- wearable breast pump

而要进一步细化为：

- wearable + hospital-grade suction
- wearable + quiet night use
- wearable + budget

因为真正的时机判断，往往发生在子组合，而不是整个大品类。

---

### 第二步：拆分公开趋势与私有先行指标

| 类型 | 关注什么 |
|------|------|
| 公开趋势 | 搜索热度、榜单、新品数量、广告同质化程度 |
| 私有先行指标 | DTC 页面访问、加购、客服问答、社群讨论、复购/退货变化 |

如果拿不到私有数据，也要明确写“当前仅基于公开信号判断，先行指标待补”。

---

### 第三步：加入竞品动作信号

不要只看需求，也要看竞争者在不在提前布局。

推荐观察：

- 是否有新专利或新品预热
- 是否有招聘动作表明进入新品类
- 广告话术是否开始转向某个新场景
- A+ 页面或 DTC 首页是否开始集中讲某种新价值

这些信号常常比搜索量更早。

---

### 第四步：阶段判断不只看“大盘”，还看“微趋势”

推荐用三层判断：

| 层级 | 问题 |
|------|------|
| 品类层 | 整个品类是在增长、平台还是衰退？ |
| 子趋势层 | 哪个功能、场景、价格带正在变化？ |
| 渠道层 | Amazon 与 DTC 对这个趋势的承接是否同步？ |

这样可以避免把“某个子需求正在起势”误判为“整个品类还在增长”。

---

### 第五步：形成时机结论

结论建议分为：

| 结论 | 含义 |
|------|------|
| 立即试探 | 早期信号已出现，适合低成本验证 |
| 结构性跟进 | 大盘一般，但某个子趋势适合 Momcozy 切入 |
| 延后观察 | 信号有，但时机未成熟或需更多私有指标确认 |
| 避免跟进 | 已高度同质化或竞争者领先太多 |
